extracted.intended_audience: marketing and design professionals at Certified B Corporations (U.S. & Canada)
extracted.subtask_description: Brand and messaging rules for B Corps in the U.S. & Canada to correctly use logos, lockups, voice, and certified naming when communicating certification and the movement. Includes required linkages, placement, color usage, and resources for storytelling and assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct Certified B Corporation logo usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Please use the Certified B Corporation logo with the line above the word "Corporation." Make sure to use the logo in either white or black, and not any other color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the Logo or URL Badge from the resources. Do not recolor the logo; only white or black are permitted. Ensure the logo includes the specified line placement (above the word "Corporation").

rubrics_metrics.name: Circle B usage restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: The "Circle B" alone should only be used by B Lab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use the standalone Circle B mark in your communications or materials — that mark is reserved for B Lab.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory link to bcorp.com when using the logo
rubrics_metrics.description: All companies must direct visitors to bcorp.com via hyperlink or text ("Learn more at bcorp.com") when using the logo by August 31, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an active hyperlink or explicit text reference to bcorp.com wherever the logo is used. This is a required action with a compliance deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tagline and logo lockup wording
rubrics_metrics.description: The top-left tagline lockup now says "high," not "highest."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the updated tagline wording in any lockups or tagline applications; replace any prior uses of "highest" with "high." Download the Tagline Lockups package to get the updated files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo lockup placement
rubrics_metrics.description: The logo lockup should be positioned in the lower-left hand corner of any promotional material — such as advertisements, window displays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applying logo lockups to promotional materials, consistently place the lockup in the lower-left corner to maintain brand consistency across touchpoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customizing lockups with company name
rubrics_metrics.description: B Corps can replace "this company" in lockup with their company name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When customizing the tagline lockup, substitute the placeholder "this company" with the company’s legal or trade name as appropriate, while preserving lockup layout and proportions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand voice principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The voice of the B Corp movement and B Lab is positive, inclusive, and credible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When announcing or talking about your certification and work as a B Corp, aim to follow these principles detailed in the brand book. Use the Storytelling deck and B Corp Talking Points to craft messages that reflect these tonal qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Styling of the Certified name
rubrics_metrics.description: Certified B Corporations, or B Corps, are companies verified by B Lab... This name is always styled as "B Corp," with a space, not "B-Corp" or "BCorp."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always use the exact styling "B Corp" (with a space) in copy. Include the ™ when appropriate (Certified B Corporation™). Avoid alternate spellings or hyphenation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Messaging about the B Corp movement's purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The B Corp movement is a global movement of People Using Business as a Force for Good® ... shifting our economic system from profiting only the few to benefitting all, ... ensuring equity, ... embracing interdependence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing the movement, emphasize systemic change framing (equity, regeneration, collective benefit) and incorporate the trademarked phrase where appropriate. Use B Lab's high-level talking points and Theory of Change as guiding content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided resources and submission process
rubrics_metrics.description: B Lab U.S. & Canada provides additional resources (Storytelling deck, Graphic Assets & Logos, For B Corps Page, Newsletter Sign Up Page, U.S. & Canada Theory of Change, B Corp Talking Points, Story Intake Form).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage the Storytelling deck and Talking Points when crafting communications; use the Graphic Assets & Logos to ensure correct visual application; submit stories via the Story Intake Form if you want B Lab U.S. & Canada to review for promotional fit. Sign up for relevant newsletters to stay updated.
